name: navbar-push-menu
title: Navbar Push Menu
description: A navbar whose menu sits behind the page. Opening it pushes the page down into a rounded, inset card and wipes the link cards up one after another, each poster settling as it lands, while the toggle fills lime and its bars cross. The bar hides as you scroll down the page, returns on the way up and blurs what passes beneath it.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/navbar-push-menu
GSAP plugins (CustomEase) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
Pass your own `links` and put your page inside as `children`; the menu band grows to fit however many cards you give it.
